issues.description: Biome formatting deviations — `npx biome check` reports the multi-line type import should collapse to one line (trackerRollup.ts:1-5), `allTasksDoneOrCanceled`'s return expression exceeds line width (trackerRollup.ts:75), `isPhaseOverdue`'s signature should wrap (trackerRollup.ts:79), and one `expect(...)` in the canceled-task test should reflow (trackerRollup.test.ts:147-149). Not gated by any hook — root `npm run lint` is `biome lint .` (format-only rules excluded) and .husky/pre-commit runs lint + typecheck, so this slipped through. `npm run lint:fix` resolves it.

The caller-scoped contract is undocumented. `rollup`, `phaseBounds` and `isPhaseOverdue` all require the caller to pre-filter `items` to the phase/project (only `isProjectOverdue` filters internally at :95,:99), and passing an unscoped list silently yields wrong bounds or progress. The neighbouring module documents its invariants with JSDoc (trackerUtils.ts:3,10) and boardViewUtils.ts:47 explains the lexical-compare trick; trackerRollup.ts carries no comments at all, which is a maintainability gap for the module the spec designates as the single place rollup correctness lives.

Tests-before-implementation (a QUALITY BAR must-have) cannot be verified from history: the range collapses to one implementation commit (507e6e0) plus a merge, because the packet's step 6 prescribes a single `git add` of all three files, and log.json records only `done_sha` with no RED/GREEN evidence. Circumstantial support is strong — both test files reproduce the packet's prescribed test blocks verbatim and trackerUtils.test.ts carries the packet's 'No implementation change is made here' header (trackerUtils.test.ts:1-4) — so this is recorded as an audit-trail observation, not a violation.
